User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the ContaHub system, managed by the Administrator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

fullName.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The Gmail address used for Google OAuth login. (Relationship: User 1:1 Authentication)

profile.description: The role or profile of the user within the system, dictating access permissions.

departmentId.description: Reference to the Department this user belongs to. (Relationship: Department 1:N User)

status.description: The current status of the user account.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who created this user account. (Relationship: User 1:N User)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client of the accounting office, including their company details, tax regime, and contact information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

corporateName.description: The legal corporate name (Razão Social) of the client.

tradeName.description: The trade name (Nome Fantasia) of the client.

cnpj.description: The CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) of the client, used for automatic data lookup.

cpf.description: The CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) of the client, if applicable for Pessoa Física clients.

stateRegistration.description: The State Registration (Inscrição Estadual) of the client.

municipalRegistration.description: The Municipal Registration (Inscrição Municipal) of the client.

taxRegime.description: The client's tax regime (Regime Tributário), influencing automatic process generation.

primaryCnae.description: The primary CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) of the client.

openingDate.description: The date when the client's business was opened (Data Abertura).

companyContactPerson.description: The name of the main contact person at the client's company.

accountingContactUserId.description: Reference to the User (Contador/Gestor) responsible for this client. (Relationship: User 1:N Client)

phone.description: The contact phone number of the client.

email.description: The contact email address of the client.

address.description: The street address of the client.

neighborhood.description: The neighborhood (bairro) of the client's address.

city.description: The city of the client's address.

state.description: The state of the client's address (e.g., 'AP').

zipCode.description: The ZIP code (CEP) of the client's address.

honorariumDueDateDay.description: The day of the month (1-31) for honorarium payment due date.

honorariumValue.description: The agreed monthly honorarium value for the client.

status.description: The current operational status of the client (e.g., Active, Inactive).

notes.description: Any additional observations or notes about the client.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the client record was created.

Process.title: Process
Process.description: Represents a specific task or process related to a client, with deadlines, responsibilities, and status tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Process entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client associated with this process. (Relationship: Client 1:N Process)

title.description: The title or short description of the process.

type.description: The specific type of the process or fiscal obligation.

description.description: A detailed description of the process.

competence.description: The month and year (MM/YYYY) to which the process or obligation refers.

dueDate.description: The official deadline for completing the process.

targetDate.description: An internal target date for completing the process before the official deadline.

responsibleUserId.description: Reference to the User responsible for this process. (Relationship: User 1:N Process)

departmentId.description: Reference to the Department responsible for this process. (Relationship: Department 1:N Process)

priority.description: The priority level of the process.

status.description: The current status of the process.

delayGeneratesFine.description: Indicates if a delay in this process will incur a fine.

recurrence.description: The recurrence pattern for this process, if any.

tags.description: A list of categorical tags associated with the process.

checklistItemIds.description: References to the checklist items associated with this process. (Relationship: Process 1:N ProcessChecklistItem)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the process record was created.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the process was marked as completed.

ProcessChecklistItem.title: ProcessChecklistItem
ProcessChecklistItem.description: Represents a single item within a process's checklist, including its status and responsibility.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProcessChecklistItem entity.

processId.description: Reference to the Process this checklist item belongs to. (Relationship: Process 1:N ProcessChecklistItem)

description.description: The description of the checklist item.

responsibleUserId.description: Reference to the User responsible for this checklist item. (Relationship: User 1:N ProcessChecklistItem)

dueDate.description: The due date for completing this checklist item.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the checklist item has been completed.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the checklist item was completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the checklist item was created.

Certificate.title: Certificate
Certificate.description: Manages negative certificates (CNDs) for clients, tracking their type, validity, and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Certificate entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client to whom this certificate belongs. (Relationship: Client 1:N Certificate)

type.description: The type of negative certificate (e.g., Federal, FGTS, Trabalhista).

emissionDate.description: The date when the certificate was issued.

validityDate.description: The date until which the certificate is valid.

certificateNumber.description: The unique number or identifier of the certificate.

status.description: The current status of the certificate's validity.

fileUrl.description: URL to the stored PDF file of the certificate.

lastConsultedAt.description: Timestamp of the last automatic or manual consultation of the certificate's status.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the certificate record was created.

Honorarium.title: Honorarium
Honorarium.description: Records accounts receivable, primarily client honorariums, tracking their value, due dates, payments, and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Honorarium entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client to whom this honorarium is owed. (Relationship: Client 1:N Honorarium)

competence.description: The month and year (MM/YYYY) for which the honorarium is due.

dueDate.description: The date when the honorarium payment is due.

paymentDate.description: The date when the honorarium was paid.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the honorarium payment.

status.description: The current payment status of the honorarium.

notes.description: Any additional observations or notes about the honorarium.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the honorarium record was created.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Manages accounts payable for the accounting office, detailing expenses, categories, and payment status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity.

category.description: The category of the expense (e.g., Salaries, Rent, Systems).

dueDate.description: The date when the expense payment is due.

paymentDate.description: The date when the expense was paid.

status.description: The current payment status of the expense.

notes.description: Any additional observations or notes about the expense.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the expense record was created.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Stores references to files (PDF, XML, images) uploaded and linked to clients or internal processes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Document entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client associated with this document. (Relationship: Client 1:N Document)

fileName.description: The original name of the uploaded file.

type.description: The file type or extension of the document.

category.description: The category of the document (e.g., Certidão, Guia, Contrato).

sizeInBytes.description: The size of the document file in bytes.

fileUrl.description: The URL or path to the stored document file in cloud storage.

competence.description: The month and year (MM/YYYY) to which the document refers, if applicable.

uploadedByUserId.description: Reference to the User who uploaded this document. (Relationship: User 1:N Document)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Stores system notifications generated for users, detailing the type of alert, message, and read status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who is the recipient of this notification. (Relationship: User 1:N Notification)

type.description: The type or category of the notification (e.g., Task Overdue, Certificate Expiring).

title.description: A short title for the notification.

message.description: The full message content of the notification.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the user has read the notification.

relatedEntity.description: The name of the entity related to this notification (e.g., 'Process', 'Client').

relatedEntityId.description: The ID of the related entity record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was generated.

ActionLog.title: ActionLog
ActionLog.description: Maintains an audit trail of all significant user actions within the system for security and accountability.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ActionLog entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action. (Relationship: User 1:N ActionLog)

action.description: A description of the action performed (e.g., 'created client', 'updated process status').

affectedEntity.description: The name of the entity that was affected by the action (e.g., 'Client', 'Process').

affectedRecordId.description: The unique identifier of the record within the affected entity.

details.description: Additional details about the action, potentially including old and new values in a JSON string format.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the action was performed.

Department.title: Department
Department.description: Defines departments within the accounting office, used for organizing users and processes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Department entity.

name.description: The name of the department (e.g., Fiscal, Pessoal).

color.description: A HEX color code associated with the department for UI representation (e.g., #RRGGBB).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the department record was created.

OfficeSetting.title: OfficeSetting
OfficeSetting.description: Stores global configuration and details for the accounting office.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OfficeSetting entity (expected to have only one record).

officeName.description: The official name of the accounting office.

cnpj.description: The CNPJ of the accounting office.

address.description: The physical address of the accounting office.

email.description: The main contact email address for the accounting office.

phone.description: The main contact phone number for the accounting office.

logoUrl.description: URL to the office's logo image.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to these settings.

updatedByUserId.description: Reference to the User who last updated these settings. (Relationship: User 1:N OfficeSetting)

FiscalObligationTemplate.title: FiscalObligationTemplate
FiscalObligationTemplate.description: Defines templates for recurring fiscal obligations, used for automatic process generation based on client tax regimes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FiscalObligationTemplate entity.

name.description: The name of the fiscal obligation (e.g., PGDAS-D, DEFIS).

description.description: A detailed description of the fiscal obligation.

taxRegime.description: The tax regime(s) this obligation applies to (e.g., MEI, Simples Nacional, All Employees).

processType.description: The type of process generated from this template (e.g., PGDAS, eSocial).

recurrence.description: The recurrence pattern of the obligation (e.g., Monthly, Annually).

dayOfMonth.description: The day of the month (1-31) when the obligation is typically due for monthly recurrences.

monthOfYear.description: The month of the year (1-12) when the obligation is typically due for annual or quarterly recurrences.

leadDaysForTaskCreation.description: Number of days before the due date to automatically create a corresponding process/task.

tags.description: A list of default tags to be applied to processes generated from this template.

delayGeneratesFine.description: Default setting indicating if a delay in this type of obligation generates a fine.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the template was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to this template.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for ContaHub is designed with a strong emphasis on Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and clear Access Modeling to ensure robust security rules and efficient querying. 

**Authorization Independence:** This is achieved primarily through strategic denormalization. For instance, entities that are inherently 'child' resources but require access control based on their 'parent' (e.g., a Client's assigned accountant or an individual Process's client ownership) will carry denormalized authorization fields. Specifically:
- Each `Client` document (`/clients/{clientId}`) will contain an `accountingContactUserId` field, linking it directly to the user responsible. This makes client-level access control direct.
- For all subcollections under a Client (e.g., `processes`, `certificates`, `honorariums`, `documents`), each document within these subcollections will denormalize `clientId` and `accountingContactUserId` from its parent `Client` document. This allows security rules to evaluate access to a `Process` or a `Certificate` without performing a `get()` operation on the parent `Client` document, thus maintaining atomic write operations and simplifying rule logic. For example, a rule for `/clients/{clientId}/processes/{processId}` can directly check `resource.data.accountingContactUserId == request.auth.uid` instead of `get(/databases/$(database)/documents/clients/$(clientId)).data.accountingContactUserId == request.auth.uid`.
- User profiles (`/users/{userId}`) will store the `profile` (role) directly on the user's document. This allows a single, efficient `get()` on the `request.auth.uid`'s own document to determine a user's role for global role-based access checks, avoiding complex hierarchical lookups.

**QAPs (Query as Authorization Patterns):** The structure facilitates secure `list` operations by aligning data ownership and access patterns with collection paths and denormalized fields.
- **Structural Segregation:** Data with different security postures is kept in separate collections. For example, `/users/{userId}/notifications` ensures that a user can only list their own notifications, as `userId` in the path must match `request.auth.uid`.
- **Path-Based Ownership:** For user-specific data like `notifications`, `/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId}` ensures that only the authenticated user (`request.auth.uid`) can access their own notifications. Similarly, `ActionLog` entries are stored globally but can be filtered by `userId` and are permissioned by role (e.g., only Admin/Sócio can list).
- **Denormalized Fields for Collection-level Queries:** For collections like `processes` or `clients`, `list` operations can enforce security by querying on the denormalized `accountingContactUserId`. For example, a `Contador/Gestor` can query `/clients` or `/clients/{clientId}/processes` and the rules will ensure they only see documents where `resource.data.accountingContactUserId == request.auth.uid`. Firebase security rules can implicitly filter `list` operations based on these conditions, acting as a powerful QAP.
- **Global Data (Admin/Socio access):** Collections like `/departments`, `/officeSettings`, `/fiscalObligationTemplates`, and `/expenses` have a homogenous security posture (e.g., read by all, write by Admin, or read-only for certain roles). Access to these collections is primarily controlled by a user's `profile` field, as fetched from `/users/{request.auth.uid}`. This allows `list` operations to be securely permitted based on the requesting user's global role.

This design minimizes rule complexity, eliminates costly cross-document `get()` calls for authorization, and creates a highly debuggable and scalable Firestore architecture.
